`manifest-verbose-oci.json` is actual output captured on 2026-10-23 from Docker 28 `docker manifest inspect --verbose ghcr.io/avdeev99/offbox-universal:1`, without pulling layers or running a container. It contains the Linux amd64 OCI image and an unknown-platform attestation. The comparable image identity is `OCIManifest.config.digest`, not the descriptor/index digest. Other manifest cases in unit tests are constructed boundary fixtures.
